hooks.command:
[ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || { printf "%s
" "Generated-file hook: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is missing; start the session in the intended checkout." >&2; exit 2; }; f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/generated-file-hook.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || { printf "%s
" "Generated-file hook: $f not found; set CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to the checkout root." >&2; exit 2; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf "%s
" "Generated-file hook: Node is missing from PATH; install the repository runtime." >&2; exit 2; }; node "$f" || { printf "%s
" "Generated-file hook: Node policy check failed; repair the runtime or shared hooks before retrying." >&2; exit 2; }

p=$(cat); case "$p" in *[gG][hH]*|*[cC][uU][rR][lL]*|*[iI][rR][mM]*|*[iI][wW][rR]*|*[iI][nN][vV][oO][kK][eE]-*) f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/typed-issue-hook.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || { printf '%s
' "typed-issue hook: $f not found; set CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to the checkout root" >&2; exit 2; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s
' 'typed-issue hook: node is not on PATH, so the command cannot be checked' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$p" | node "$f" || { printf '%s
' 'typed-issue hook: the check itself failed, so the command is refused' >&2; exit 2; };; esac

p=$(cat); case "$p" in *[sS][tT][aA][sS][hH]*) f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/shared-stash-hook.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || { printf '%s

' 'stash hook: node is not on PATH, so the command cannot be checked' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$p" | node "$f" || { printf '%s
' 'stash hook: the check itself failed, so the command is refused' >&2; exit 2; };; esac
